item.title: FHSAA combines rural and Class 1A to create more even playing field for small schools
item.description: Florida High School Athletic Association officials recently voted to combine Rural Class and Class 1A into a single classification, according to reports. The new classification will begin with the upcoming season. This upcoming season, Northview will move from Class 1A Rural to Class 1A. According to FHSAA’s website, policy 12.3.2.1 requires at least 24 schools for there to be a rural classification. item.title: 19th annual Rosa Parks Breakfast will be held this Sat., February 7
item.description: 19th annual Rosa Parks Breakfast set for Sat., Feb. 7, 9 a.m. at Greater Mount Triumph Missionary Baptist Church, featuring MPS Superintendent Dr. Zickeyous Byrd as keynote speaker.

item.title: City hall ceremony honors first graduates of Atmore Police Department Youth Explorer Program
item.description: Atmore Police honored the first graduates of its free, two‑month Youth Explorer Program, whose weekly after‑school training leads to volunteer roles with the department.

item.title: Atmore chamber partners with Grace Fellowship Atmore to support Upward Sports program

item.title: Julia LaFaye Hubert
item.description: Julia LaFaye Hubert, of Atmore, passed away on Fri., January 30, 2026 at Sacred Heart Hospital in Pensacola, Fla. A viewing will be held this Fri., February 6, 2026 from 5 p.m. until 8 p.m. in the funeral home chapel. A funeral service will be held this Sat., February 7, 2026 at 11 a.m. at Faith Tabernacle with Christian Memorial Funeral Home directing.
